explication: LocalStack is a local AWS cloud emulator. An application or SDK sends an AWS request to the edge gateway; handlers parse and validate it, routing it through the service registry to an emulated AWS service, which returns a serialized result. The repository also models infrastructure lifecycle and specialized capabilities including queues, event matching, Lambda invocation, databases, OpenSearch, DNS, certificates, CloudFormation, and Step Functions. Several service relationships remain intentionally unconnected because their implementations were not sampled.
